summary: GO-LIVE manual test pack for the Call Logs / Smart Outreach module of Saranam India Health Care. The module is rendered by CallLogsPage and is an admin-only outbound communication hub built on the Exotel telephony API. It contains four primary tabs: Dial (priority outreach queue + staff registry sidebar + live Call HUD), History (call logs from Exotel + SOP documentation history), Escalated (persisted SOP escalations), and Scheduler (persistent outreach schedule with auto-generate). It also includes a SOP documentation modal, a per-agent on-duty toggle, and an EmailModal component (orphaned in code, see defects). All API calls go through axios apiClient with baseURL VITE_API_URL (default http://localhost:5000/api) and a Bearer access_token request interceptor; a 401 triggers a token-refresh-then-retry, and if refresh fails the user is redirected to /login.
in_scope: Permission / route guard: admin-only access to /call-logs and visibility of the sidebar 'Call Logs' item
Dial tab: priority outreach queue (OutreachQueueView), patient search, pagination, status badges, call/caregiver dropdown, schedule-for-later popover, manual SOP open
Staff Registry sidebar (StaffSidebar): on-duty toggle, available count, busy state, pagination, empty state
Live Call HUD (CallHUD): live session list, expand/collapse, document (SOP) and end-session actions, call-status polling
Initiating a call (Exotel make-call) including from/to derivation, no-available-staff guard, missing-number guard, 403 credential error
SOP documentation modal: capture severity/relationship/reason/symptoms/advice/notes, escalate flag, save, view existing SOP

History tab: Call Logs sub-tab (Exotel calls list, recording playback, status colours, empty/error states, stat cards), SOP Documentation sub-tab (paginated history), date-range filter, refresh, export
Escalated tab: persisted escalations list, severity colour bar, HomeCare action, Follow Up scheduling popover, Dismiss
Scheduler tab: persistent schedule list, add to schedule, remove, auto-generate weekly plan, empty state
EmailModal: compose subject/body, required-field disabling, send, cancel (tested at component/intended level — see orphaned-component defect)
API-level validation of every endpoint in api/call-log.js and backend/app/call_logs/routes.py with payloads and 2xx/4xx/5xx handling
Data integrity: SOP appears in history and against patient; escalation flag surfaces in Escalated; schedule add/remove reflects in list
out_of_scope: Exotel telephony internals, actual voice connectivity, recording generation, and Exotel-side billing
Inbound routing webhook (/api/exotel/inbound) behaviour from Exotel's side (server-to-server, not user-facing UI)
Patients module CRUD, Providers module CRUD (validated only as data dependencies)
SMTP server provisioning and email deliverability (only the send-email request/response contract is in scope)
Backend unit tests, load/performance testing, and penetration testing
HomeCare referral routing (handleEscalateToHomeCare is a client-only stub with a TODO; no API call is made)

roles_and_access: The /call-logs route is wrapped in ProtectedRoute requiredRole='admin'. hasRole(role) returns user?.role === role, so ONLY a user whose role is exactly 'admin' may render CallLogsPage; any other role (data_entry, viewer) sees a full-page 'Access Denied' message, and an unauthenticated user is redirected to /login. NOTE (defect): the DashboardLayout sidebar item {name:'Call Logs', href:'/call-logs', permission:null} is filtered by `!item.permission || hasPermission(item.permission)`; because permission is null the item is ALWAYS shown, so it is NOT hidden for non-admins (they see it but are blocked on click). API auth is inconsistent: /api/exotel/agents, /agent-status, /sop, /sop/history, /scheduler (all methods), /scheduler/auto-generate and /send-email require @jwt_required(); but /api/exotel/calls, /make-call, /call-status/<sid> and /inbound have NO JWT guard and are publicly reachable.

api_endpoints.purpose: List Exotel call logs; query params start_date, end_date. Returns {Calls:[...]}. NO JWT guard. 500 {error} on Exotel failure.
Initiate outbound call. Body {from,to,patient_name,provider_name}. 400 if from/to missing; passes through Exotel status (e.g. 403 invalid creds), 500 on request exception. NO JWT guard.
Fetch live status of a call SID. Returns {Call:{Status,...}}. Passes through Exotel error code, else 500. NO JWT guard.
List active providers joined with persistent on-duty status (is_on_duty mapped to active). JWT required (401 if missing). 200 array.
Set agent on-duty status. Body {provider_id,is_on_duty}. 400 if either missing; 200 on success. JWT required.
List escalated SOP records. Returns {escalations:[...]}. JWT required. 200.
Save SOP documentation for a call. Body is full SOP payload incl. patient_id, severity, escalate, etc. 201 on success. JWT required.
Paginated SOP documentation history. Query start_date,end_date,page,per_page. Returns {items:[...],total}. JWT required. 200.
List persistent scheduled outreach calls. Query start_date,end_date. Returns {schedule:[...]}. JWT required. 200.
Add patient to outreach schedule. Body {patient_id,scheduled_date,notes}. 400 if patient_id or scheduled_date missing; 201 on success. JWT required.
Remove a schedule record by UUID. 200 on success; 404 if not found; route expects a valid uuid (non-uuid path = 404 routing). JWT required.
Auto-generate next-week outreach plan. No body. 201 on success. JWT required.

Send follow-up email to a patient. Body {patient_id,subject,body}. 400 if any missing; 404 if patient/email not found; 400 if no email on file; 500 if SMTP not configured; 200 on success. JWT required. (UI caller is orphaned — see defects.)
Exotel dynamic-routing webhook (server-to-server). Out of UI scope; listed for completeness.

test_data_setup: Admin user (role='admin') with valid credentials, e.g. admin@saranam.test, to access /call-logs.
A non-admin user (role='data_entry' or 'viewer') to verify Access Denied.

At least 12 patients so pagination (PER_PAGE=10) produces 2 pages. Include: a patient with NO last_call_date (expect 'NEVER CONTACTED'), one called today (expect 'CONTACTED TODAY'), one called ~3 days ago (expect 'SCHEDULED'), one called >7 days ago (expect 'OVERDUE - 7D+').

At least one patient WITH primary_caregiver_phone + primary_caregiver_name (e.g. Lakshmi Iyer, caregiver +91 98860 12345) to exercise the Call Options dropdown, and at least one WITHOUT a caregiver (single Call button).
A patient with a valid +91 mobile (e.g. Ramesh Kumar, +91 99000 11223) and one with NO phone on file to exercise the missing-number guard.
A patient with a valid email on file and one with NO email on file (for send-email 400/404 paths).
At least 2 active HealthcareProviders so the Staff Registry shows togglable agents; ensure at least one can be set On Duty.
Backend Exotel env vars (ACCOUNT_SID, API_KEY, API_TOKEN, EXOTEL_CALLER_ID): a valid set for happy path, plus a way to force a 403 (invalid API_KEY/API_TOKEN) to test the credential-error toast.
Pre-seed at least one escalated SOP record (escalate=true, severity 'high') and several non-escalated SOP records spanning the date range, for History/Escalated coverage.
Pre-seed at least one scheduler record (or add one during testing) to validate list, remove, and date display.
Browser DevTools Network + Console open for every API-level case; React error overlay enabled in non-prod to catch hook-order crashes.

test_cases.title: Admin can open /call-logs and lands on the Dial tab
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin user; at least 1 patient and 1 provider exist.
steps: Log in as the admin user.
Navigate to https://saranam.fieldintel.ai/call-logs (or click the 'Call Logs' sidebar item).
Observe the page header and the active tab.
test_cases.expected_result: Page renders with title 'Smart Outreach' and subtitle 'Integrated patient communication hub and automated call history.'. The 'Dial' tab is active by default; Dial/History/Escalated/Scheduler toggle buttons are visible; the Staff Registry sidebar is shown.

test_cases.title: Non-admin user is blocked from /call-logs (Access Denied)
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as a non-admin user (role data_entry or viewer).
steps: Log in as a non-admin user.
Manually navigate to /call-logs via the URL bar.
Observe the rendered content.
test_cases.expected_result: ProtectedRoute renders a full-page 'Access Denied' message ('You don't have permission to access this page.'); CallLogsPage and its API calls do NOT execute.

test_cases.title: 'Call Logs' sidebar item visibility for a non-admin (KNOWN DEFECT)
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as a non-admin user; DashboardLayout sidebar visible.
steps: Log in as a non-admin user (viewer/data_entry).
Open the left navigation sidebar.
Look for the 'Call Logs' menu item.
Click it if present.
test_cases.expected_result: EXPECTED PER REQUIREMENT: the 'Call Logs' item should be hidden for non-admins. ACTUAL (defect): the nav entry has permission:null and is filtered by `!item.permission || hasPermission(...)`, so it is ALWAYS shown; the non-admin sees 'Call Logs' and on click reaches the 'Access Denied' page. Log as FAIL and reference DEF-CL-01.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated user is redirected to /login
test_cases.preconditions: No active session (localStorage cleared of access_token/user).
steps: Clear site data / log out so there is no user in context.
Navigate directly to /call-logs.
test_cases.expected_result: ProtectedRoute sees no user and redirects (Navigate replace) to /login. CallLogsPage does not render.

test_cases.title: Expired access token on a guarded call triggers refresh then retry
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin; access_token expired but a valid refresh_token present.
steps: Set access_token in localStorage to an expired/invalid token, keep a valid refresh_token.
Open /call-logs (triggers GET /api/exotel/agents).
Watch the Network tab.
test_cases.expected_result: First agents call returns 401; client posts /auth/refresh with the refresh token, stores the new access_token, and retries the original request which now succeeds (200). Staff Registry populates without forcing logout.

test_cases.title: Failed token refresh on 401 logs the user out to /login
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin; both access_token and refresh_token invalid/expired.
steps: Invalidate both access_token and refresh_token in localStorage.
Open /call-logs.
Observe redirect behaviour.
test_cases.expected_result: Guarded call returns 401, refresh attempt fails, client clears access_token/refresh_token/user from localStorage and redirects to /login.

test_cases.title: Dial tab loads the priority outreach queue with patients and pagination footer
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on /call-logs, >10 patients seeded.
steps: Open the Dial tab.
Observe the 'Patients' card titled 'Priority Outreach Queue'.
Read the footer 'Showing X to Y of Z' text.
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/patients (page=1, per_page=10, search='') is called; up to 10 patient rows render with name, patient phone, last sync date and a status badge; footer reads 'Showing 1 to 10 of 12'; Next enabled, Previous disabled on page 1.

test_cases.title: Queue sorts by outreach priority (overdue > never > scheduled > recent)
test_cases.preconditions: Patients seeded with varied last_call_date values as per test data setup.
steps: Open the Dial tab.
Inspect the order of the patient rows and their badges.
test_cases.test_data: Patients with last_call_date = none / today / 3 days ago / 8 days ago
test_cases.expected_result: Rows are ordered so OVERDUE - 7D+ appears first, then NEVER CONTACTED, then SCHEDULED, then CONTACTED TODAY (client-side sort by getCallStatus priority {overdue:3, never:2, scheduled:1, recent:0}).

test_cases.title: Patient status badges render correctly for each call-recency bucket
test_cases.preconditions: Patients seeded per CL-008.
steps: Open the Dial tab.
Match each patient row's badge against its last_call_date.
test_cases.expected_result: No last_call_date -> 'NEVER CONTACTED' (amber). <1 day -> 'CONTACTED TODAY' (emerald). 1-7 days -> 'SCHEDULED' (blue). >7 days -> 'OVERDUE - 7D+' (red, pulsing). Last Sync shows the formatted date or 'None'.

test_cases.title: Patient search filters the queue (debounced) by name
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; patient 'Ramesh Kumar' exists.
steps: Type 'Ramesh' into the 'Search patient or phone...' box.
Wait ~300ms and observe the Network tab and the list.
test_cases.expected_result: After the 300ms debounce a single GET /api/patients call fires with search=Ramesh; the list updates to matching patients. (Note: results are additionally filtered client-side by name/phone via sortedPatients.)

test_cases.title: Patient search by phone substring filters the visible rows
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; a patient with phone +91 99000 11223 exists.
steps: Type '99000' into the search box.
Observe the filtered rows.
test_cases.expected_result: Rows are filtered to patients whose phone contains '99000' (client-side sortedPatients filter on p.phone). Non-matching rows are hidden.

test_cases.title: Outreach queue pagination Next/Previous navigates pages
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; 12 patients (2 pages).
steps: On page 1, click 'Next' in the queue footer.
Observe the list and footer.
Click 'Previous'.
test_cases.expected_result: Next sets patientPage=2 -> GET /api/patients?page=2; footer reads 'Showing 11 to 12 of 12'; Next is disabled on the last page; Previous returns to page 1.

test_cases.title: Empty outreach queue shows 'No patients found.'
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; search yields zero patients.
steps: Type a string matching no patient, e.g. 'zzzzqqq'.
Wait for the list to settle.
test_cases.expected_result: The queue body shows the italic empty message 'No patients found.' and no patient rows; footer count reflects 0.

test_cases.title: Loading skeleton displays while patients are being fetched
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; throttle network to Slow 3G in DevTools.
steps: Throttle the network.
Switch to / refresh the Dial tab.
Observe the Patients card during loading.
test_cases.expected_result: While patientsLoading is true the CallLogCard renders skeleton placeholders (title/description/300px body skeleton) instead of rows; rows appear once data resolves.

test_cases.title: Patients fetch failure shows 'Sync Failed' destructive toast
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; force GET /api/patients to return 500 (e.g. block the endpoint).
steps: Force the patients endpoint to error (DevTools request block or backend down).
Open / refresh the Dial tab.
test_cases.expected_result: A destructive toast 'Sync Failed - Could not retrieve patients.' is shown; the queue does not crash and shows the empty state.

test_cases.title: Caregiver patient shows 'Call Options' dropdown with Patient and Caregiver
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; patient with primary_caregiver_phone exists; at least one On Duty staff.
steps: Locate the caregiver-enabled patient row (caregiver phone shown in blue).
Click the 'Call Options' button.
Inspect the dropdown menu.
test_cases.expected_result: A dropdown opens with label 'Select Contact', a 'Call Patient' item (patient phone) and a 'Call Caregiver' item (caregiver phone + name). Patients with no caregiver render a single 'Call' button instead.

test_cases.title: Schedule-for-later popover requires a date before Confirm is enabled
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab.
steps: Click the amber calendar button on a patient row.
Observe the 'Confirm Schedule' button before picking a date.
Pick a future date, then observe the button.
test_cases.expected_result: 'Confirm Schedule' is disabled until a date is selected; once a date is chosen it becomes enabled. Confirming triggers the add-to-schedule flow (CL-046) and resets the temp date.

test_cases.title: Staff Registry loads agents with On Duty/Off and 'Ready' count
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; >=2 active providers.
steps: Observe the right-hand 'Staff Registry - Active care providers' card.
Read each agent's status chip and the header 'X Ready' badge.
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/exotel/agents returns providers; each renders initial avatar, name, 'On Duty'/'Off' chip and (if applicable) 'Busy'; header badge shows count of agents that are active AND not busy.

test_cases.title: Toggle an agent On Duty persists via PUT and updates optimistically
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; agent currently Off.
steps: Click the toggle (PhoneForwarded) button on an Off agent.
Observe the chip and the 'Ready' count.
Check the Network tab for the PUT call and payload.
test_cases.expected_result: Chip flips to 'On Duty' immediately (optimistic); PUT /api/exotel/agent-status fires with body {provider_id, is_on_duty:true} and returns 200; 'Ready' count increments.

test_cases.title: Agent-status PUT failure reverts the optimistic toggle
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; force PUT /api/exotel/agent-status to 500.
steps: Block / fail the agent-status endpoint in DevTools.
Toggle an agent's duty status.
Observe the chip after the request fails.
test_cases.expected_result: Chip first flips optimistically then reverts to its previous state when the PUT rejects; no crash. (Note: no error toast is shown on this path — confirm chip reversion only.)

test_cases.title: All staff off/busy shows 'Full busy / offline' warning
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; at least one agent exists but none are available.
steps: Toggle all agents to Off (or ensure all are busy).
Observe the bottom of the Staff Registry.
test_cases.expected_result: When availableCount is 0 but agents exist, the amber 'Full busy / offline' banner is shown and the header badge reads '0 Ready'.

test_cases.title: No staff returns empty registry message
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; no active providers in DB.
steps: Open the Dial tab with zero active providers.
Observe the Staff Registry body.
test_cases.expected_result: The registry shows the empty state 'No staff members found.' with a user icon; header badge reads '0 Ready'.

test_cases.title: Staff Registry client-side pagination
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; >10 active providers.
steps: Observe 'Page 1 / N' footer.
Click 'Next', then 'Previous'.
test_cases.expected_result: Agents are paginated client-side (slice of 10); footer shows correct page; Previous disabled on page 1, Next disabled on the last page. No new network call (agents already in memory).

test_cases.title: Initiate a call to a patient with an available agent succeeds
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; at least one On Duty + not-busy agent; patient with a valid +91 number; valid Exotel creds.
steps: Ensure one agent is On Duty.
Click 'Call' (or 'Call Patient' from the dropdown) on a patient with a phone number.
Observe the toast, the button label, the Live HUD and the Network tab.
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/make-call fires with {from: agent clean phone, to: patient clean phone, patient_name, provider_name}; a 'Call Initiated' toast appears; the agent becomes Busy; a Live Session appears in the Call HUD; on a returned Sid the button reads 'Connected'.

test_cases.title: Call blocked when no staff are On Duty
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; all agents Off (or busy).
steps: Ensure no agent is available.
Click 'Call' on any patient.
test_cases.expected_result: No make-call request is sent; a destructive toast 'Staff Offline - Please set at least one staff member to On Duty in the sidebar before calling.' is shown.

test_cases.title: Call blocked when the target patient has no phone number
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; one agent On Duty; a patient with no phone on file.
steps: Click 'Call' on the patient that has no phone.
Observe the toast.
test_cases.expected_result: No make-call request; destructive toast 'Missing Number - Could not find phone number for Target.' is shown (and 'Staff' if the agent number is missing).

test_cases.title: Initiate a call to the caregiver number from the dropdown
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; agent On Duty; caregiver-enabled patient.
steps: Open 'Call Options' on the caregiver patient.
Click 'Call Caregiver'.
Inspect the make-call payload.
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/make-call uses the caregiver's cleaned phone as 'to'; the HUD session name reflects the caregiver/target name; patient_name in the payload is still the patient's full_name.

test_cases.title: Exotel 403 (invalid credentials) shows Authentication Failed toast
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; agent On Duty; backend Exotel API_KEY/API_TOKEN invalid.
steps: Click 'Call' on a valid patient.
Observe the toast and Network response.
test_cases.expected_result: make-call passes through a 403 from Exotel; UI shows destructive toast 'Authentication Failed - Exotel credentials (API Key/Token) are invalid. Please check your configuration.'; the agent's busy flag is cleared and the temp session is removed.

test_cases.title: Generic make-call failure (500) shows Dial Error and clears session
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab; agent On Duty; force make-call to return 500.
steps: Force the make-call endpoint to 500.
Click 'Call' on a valid patient.
Observe the toast and the HUD.
test_cases.expected_result: Destructive toast 'Dial Error' with the error message (fallback 'Failed to connect call via Exotel.'); the optimistic Live Session is removed and the agent is no longer Busy.

test_cases.title: make-call request omitting from/to is rejected (400) by backend
test_cases.preconditions: Tooling to POST directly (Postman/curl) to the backend.
steps: POST /api/exotel/make-call with body {} (no from/to).
Inspect the response.
test_cases.expected_result: Backend returns 400 with {"error":"Missing from or to number"}.

test_cases.title: Re-clicking Call on an already-dialing patient is prevented
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; a call is already initiated for a patient (HUD session active).
steps: Initiate a call on a patient.
Attempt to click the same patient's call button again while it shows 'Dialing...'/'Connected'.
test_cases.expected_result: The button is disabled (isCalling true) and shows a spinner with 'Dialing...' then 'Connected'; no duplicate make-call is sent for that patient.

test_cases.title: Call HUD appears with active sessions and collapses/expands
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; at least one active call session.
steps: Initiate a call so a session is active.
Observe the fixed bottom-right HUD header 'Live Sessions (N)'.
Click the chevron to collapse, then expand.
test_cases.expected_result: HUD shows a pulsing green dot and 'Live Sessions (1)'; each row shows patient/target name and 'with <first agent name>'. Chevron toggles the body open/closed. With zero sessions the HUD is not rendered.

test_cases.title: End Session from the HUD frees the agent and removes the session
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; an active call session in the HUD; agent marked Busy.
steps: In the HUD, click the red X 'End Session' on the session.
Observe the HUD, the toast and the agent's Busy chip.
test_cases.expected_result: The session is removed from the HUD; toast 'Call Session Ended - You are now available for new calls.'; the associated agent's Busy flag clears (becomes available again).

test_cases.title: Document (SOP) button in HUD opens the SOP modal pre-filled
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; an active session in the HUD.
steps: Click the clipboard 'Document Call (SOP)' icon on a HUD session.
Observe the SOP modal.
test_cases.expected_result: The SOP Documentation modal opens with Patient Name pre-filled from the session and editable SOP fields (see CL-037).

test_cases.title: Call-status polling auto-ends a session on terminal status
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; an active session that has a returned Exotel Sid.
steps: Initiate a call that returns a Sid.
Have the call reach a terminal status (completed/failed/busy/no-answer/canceled) on the Exotel side.
Wait up to ~5s and observe the HUD.
test_cases.expected_result: Every 5s the UI polls GET /api/exotel/call-status/<sid>; when the returned Status is terminal the session is auto-ended (removed from HUD, agent freed). Failed status checks are swallowed silently.

test_cases.title: Dialing session auto-clears after 30s if it never connects
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; a make-call that never transitions to in-progress (no Sid).
steps: Initiate a call where no Sid/in-progress status is returned.
Wait ~30 seconds without acting.
Observe the HUD and the agent status.
test_cases.expected_result: After 30s the unconnected session is removed and the agent's Busy flag is cleared automatically (per the setTimeout cleanup). A session already 'in-progress' is left intact.

test_cases.title: Open SOP modal from a queue row and verify all fields
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab.
steps: Click the clipboard 'Manual Documentation' button on a patient row.
Inspect every field in the modal.
test_cases.expected_result: Modal 'Call Documentation / SOP Compliance Form' opens. Patient Name is disabled/pre-filled; editable fields: Staff/Clinician Name, Staff Phone No., Patient Phone Number, Relation (self/spouse/child/sibling/caregiver/other), Severity (low/medium/high/critical), Reason, Symptoms, Advice, Internal Notes, and an 'Flag for Roster Lead Escalation' checkbox. Close (X) and 'Save Documentation' buttons present.

test_cases.title: Save SOP documentation persists and shows success toast
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; SOP modal open for a known patient.
steps: Fill Staff Name, Reason ('Fever follow-up'), Severity 'medium', Symptoms, Advice.
Click 'Save Documentation'.
Inspect the toast and the POST payload.
test_cases.test_data: Staff: Nurse Priya; Reason: Fever follow-up; Severity: medium
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/sop fires with the full sopData plus patient_id from selectedCall; returns 201; toast 'SOP Saved - Documentation has been persisted to the patient record.'; modal closes.

test_cases.title: Save SOP with the escalate flag checked refreshes the Escalated list
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; SOP modal open; severity high.
steps: Set Severity 'high', tick 'Flag for Roster Lead Escalation', add a Reason.
Click 'Save Documentation'.
Switch to the Escalated tab.
test_cases.test_data: Severity: high; escalate: true; Reason: Severe breathlessness
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/sop succeeds; after save the app calls GET /api/exotel/sop (escalations) again; the new escalation appears in the Escalated tab with red severity bar and 'high priority' badge.

test_cases.title: SOP save failure shows destructive toast with status code
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; SOP modal open; force POST /api/exotel/sop to 500.
steps: Force the SOP endpoint to error.
Fill the form and click 'Save Documentation'.
test_cases.expected_result: Destructive toast 'Save Failed (500)' (or the returned code) with the backend error message or fallback 'Could not save SOP documentation.'; the modal remains open so data is not lost.

test_cases.title: SOP free-text fields accept long text and special characters
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; SOP modal open.
steps: Paste a 2000+ character string into Symptoms and Internal Notes.
Enter special characters & non-Latin script in Reason (e.g. 'Fever <>&\"' and 'காய்ச்சல்').
Save and re-open via History > SOP Documentation > View Details.
test_cases.test_data: Long Lorem text; Reason: Fever <>&\" காய்ச்சல்
test_cases.expected_result: Long text and special/Unicode characters are accepted, saved (no truncation error, no script injection), and render correctly when viewed; no XSS executes.

test_cases.title: Close / X dismisses the SOP modal without saving
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; SOP modal open with edits.
steps: Enter some text in Reason.
Click the header X (and separately the footer 'Close').
Confirm no save occurred.
test_cases.expected_result: Either control closes the modal; no POST /api/exotel/sop is sent; the entered data is discarded (modal state resets on next open).

test_cases.title: History tab loads Exotel call logs and stat cards
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; Exotel returns calls for the default range (last 1 month).
steps: Click the 'History' tab.
Observe the four stat cards and the Call Logs sub-tab list.
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/exotel/calls is called with start_date/end_date; stat cards show Total Volume, Inbound, Outbound, Failed/Missed (failed counts statuses failed/no-answer/busy). The CallLogs list renders one card per call with From -> To, date, duration, and a status badge.

test_cases.title: Call log status badge colours map correctly
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; calls with mixed statuses (completed/busy/failed/no-answer).
steps: On the History > Call Logs sub-tab, inspect each call card's status badge.
test_cases.expected_result: completed -> green, busy -> amber, failed -> red, no-answer -> gray; an unknown status falls back to the muted/secondary style.

test_cases.title: Call recording player renders only when a RecordingUrl exists
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; at least one call with RecordingUrl and one without.
steps: Locate a call card that has a recording and one that does not.
Verify the audio player presence and that it plays.
test_cases.expected_result: Cards with RecordingUrl show a 'Recording' label and an HTML5 audio player that streams the source; cards without a recording show no player.

test_cases.title: Date-range filter re-queries call logs
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on History tab.
steps: Open the DateRangePicker and select a narrower custom range.
Observe the Network call and the refreshed list/stats.
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/exotel/calls fires with the new start_date/end_date (ISO); both the stat cards and the call list refresh to reflect that window.

test_cases.title: Refresh button re-fetches the active History sub-tab
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on History tab.
steps: Click the refresh (RefreshCw) icon button.
Observe the spinner and the Network tab.
test_cases.expected_result: On the Call Logs sub-tab it re-calls GET /api/exotel/calls (stat refresh); on the SOP sub-tab it re-calls GET /api/exotel/sop/history. The icon animates (spins) while loading.

test_cases.title: Empty call history shows 'No call logs found'
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; choose a range with no calls (e.g. far-future window).
steps: Select a date range with no calls.
Observe the Call Logs list.
test_cases.expected_result: The list shows the dashed empty card 'No call logs found' with the phone icon and helper text; stat cards read 0.

test_cases.title: Call logs fetch error shows connection alert
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on History tab; force GET /api/exotel/calls to fail.
steps: Block / fail the calls endpoint.
Open / refresh the Call Logs sub-tab.
test_cases.expected_result: A destructive Alert 'Unable to connect to the call server. Please check your connection.' is shown inside the CallLogs list; the page does not crash.

test_cases.title: Export button generates a call-history export for the range
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on History tab with data in range.
steps: Click the Export button.
Observe the produced export/download.
test_cases.expected_result: The ExportButton receives exportData {summary: stats, range, message} and viewType 'call_history' and produces an export reflecting the current date range summary. (No new Exotel call required for the summary export.)

test_cases.title: SOP Documentation sub-tab lists paginated records
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on History tab; >10 SOP records in range.
steps: Switch the History sub-tab to 'SOP Documentation'.
Observe the list, record count footer and pagination.
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/exotel/sop/history?page=1&per_page=10 is called; up to 10 cards show patient name, 'By: <staff>', patient number, created date and a quoted reason; footer 'Showing 10 of 12'; Next enabled. Escalated records show a red 'Escalated' badge.

test_cases.title: SOP history pagination Next/Previous
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on SOP Documentation sub-tab; 12 records.
steps: Click 'Next'.
Observe the page change and Network call.
Click 'Previous'.
test_cases.expected_result: Next sets sopPage=2 -> GET /api/exotel/sop/history?page=2; Previous disabled on page 1; Next disabled when sopPage*per_page >= total.

test_cases.title: Empty SOP history shows 'No documentation found'
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; date range with no SOP records.
steps: Select a range with no SOP entries and open the SOP Documentation sub-tab.
Observe the body.
test_cases.expected_result: Dashed empty card 'No documentation found - Stored SOP forms for the selected period will appear here.' is shown.

test_cases.title: View Details opens the SOP modal pre-filled from the record
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; at least one SOP record listed.
steps: Click 'View Details' on an SOP card.
Inspect the modal contents.
test_cases.expected_result: The SOP modal opens populated with the stored record's fields (patientName from sop.patient.full_name and the persisted reason/severity/etc.), allowing review.

test_cases.title: SOP history fetch error shows destructive toast
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; force GET /api/exotel/sop/history to fail.
steps: Block the sop/history endpoint.
Open the SOP Documentation sub-tab.
test_cases.expected_result: Destructive toast 'History Sync Failed - Could not retrieve documentation history.' is shown; no crash.

test_cases.title: Escalated tab lists persisted escalations with severity colour bar
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; >=1 escalated SOP record seeded.
steps: Click the 'Escalated' tab.
Inspect the escalation card(s).
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/exotel/sop is called; each escalation renders patient name, severity badge, staff name/number, patient caller number, relative time, quoted reason and symptoms; the left colour bar is red(high)/amber(medium)/emerald(else).

test_cases.title: Empty escalations show 'No pending escalations'
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; no escalated records.
steps: Open the Escalated tab with no escalations.
Observe the body.
test_cases.expected_result: Dashed empty card 'No pending escalations - Calls flagged for Lead review will appear here.' is shown.

test_cases.title: HomeCare button removes the escalation from the list (client stub)
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; >=1 escalation listed.
steps: Click the 'HomeCare' button on an escalation card.
Observe the toast and the list, and the Network tab.
test_cases.expected_result: Success toast 'Escalated to HomeCare - A new visit request has been added to the HomeCare queue.'; the card is removed from the local list. NOTE (defect/limitation): handleEscalateToHomeCare is a client-only stub (TODO) — NO backend API call is made, so the change is not persisted and reappears on refresh. Reference DEF-CL-05.

test_cases.title: Follow Up popover schedules the escalation's patient
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; >=1 escalation with a patient_id.
steps: Click 'Follow Up' on an escalation card.
Pick a date in the calendar and click 'Confirm Schedule'.
Inspect the Network call and toast.
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/scheduler fires with {patient_id, scheduled_date (ISO), notes}; success toast 'Added to Schedule'; the schedule list refreshes (visible on the Scheduler tab).

test_cases.title: Dismiss for now removes an escalation from the view only
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; >=1 escalation listed.
steps: Click 'Dismiss for now' on an escalation.
Refresh the Escalated tab.
test_cases.expected_result: The card disappears from the current view with no API call; after a refresh (re-fetch of GET /api/exotel/sop) the escalation reappears (dismiss is client-only / non-persistent).

test_cases.title: Scheduler tab loads the persistent outreach schedule
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; >=1 schedule record exists.
steps: Click the 'Scheduler' tab.
Observe the 'Your Outreach Schedule' list and count.
test_cases.expected_result: GET /api/exotel/scheduler is called; each record shows patient initial avatar, name, phone and 'Scheduled: <relative date>'; the count line reads 'N patients scheduled for follow-up.'

test_cases.title: Empty schedule shows 'No calls scheduled'
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; no schedule records.
steps: Open the Scheduler tab with no records.
Observe the body.
test_cases.expected_result: Dashed empty card 'No calls scheduled - Add patients from the Dial tab to build your outreach plan.' is shown along with the Generate/Add Manually buttons.

test_cases.title: Add patient to schedule from the Dial tab persists
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Dial tab.
steps: Open a patient's schedule calendar (amber button) and pick a future date, confirm.
Switch to the Scheduler tab.
Inspect the Network call and the list.
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/scheduler fires with {patient_id, scheduled_date (ISO), notes:'Scheduled from Outreach Management'} returning 201; success toast 'Added to Schedule'; the new record appears in the Scheduler list after fetchSchedule.

test_cases.title: Remove a scheduled record deletes it from the list
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Scheduler tab; >=1 record.
steps: Click the X 'Remove from Schedule' on a record.
Observe the toast, the list, and the Network call.
test_cases.expected_result: DELETE /api/exotel/scheduler/<uuid> returns 200; success toast 'Removed - Record removed from schedule.'; the record is removed from the list and stays removed after refresh.

test_cases.title: Remove schedule failure shows destructive toast
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; force DELETE /api/exotel/scheduler to fail.
steps: Block / fail the delete endpoint.
Click X on a schedule record.
test_cases.expected_result: Destructive toast 'Action Failed - Could not remove from schedule.'; the record remains in the list.

test_cases.title: Generate Weekly Plan auto-generates the schedule
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Scheduler tab.
steps: Click 'Generate Weekly Plan'.
Observe the spinner, toast and refreshed list.
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/scheduler/auto-generate returns 201; success toast 'Plan Generated - Automatic outreach plan for next week has been created.'; fetchSchedule re-runs and the list updates.

test_cases.title: Auto-generate failure shows destructive toast
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; force auto-generate to fail.
steps: Block / fail the auto-generate endpoint.
Click 'Generate Weekly Plan'.
test_cases.expected_result: Destructive toast 'Generation Failed - Could not automatically generate the schedule.'; spinner stops.

test_cases.title: 'Add Manually' switches to the Dial tab; manual SOP from a schedule row opens the modal
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on Scheduler tab; >=1 record.
steps: Click 'Add Manually' and confirm the tab switch.
Return to Scheduler and click the clipboard (Manual Documentation) icon on a record.
test_cases.expected_result: 'Add Manually' sets the active tab to Dial. The clipboard icon on a schedule record opens the SOP modal pre-filled with that record's patient.

test_cases.title: Backend rejects schedule add missing patient_id or scheduled_date (400)
test_cases.preconditions: Tooling to POST directly with a valid JWT.
steps: POST /api/exotel/scheduler with body {notes:'x'} (no patient_id/scheduled_date).
Inspect the response.
test_cases.expected_result: Backend returns 400 {"error":"patient_id and scheduled_date are required"}.

test_cases.title: Delete with a non-existent / non-UUID schedule id
test_cases.preconditions: Tooling to DELETE directly with a valid JWT.
steps: DELETE /api/exotel/scheduler/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (valid uuid, no record).
Then DELETE /api/exotel/scheduler/not-a-uuid.
Inspect both responses.
test_cases.expected_result: Absent uuid -> 404 {"error":"Schedule not found"} (or 200 no-op depending on service). Non-uuid path does not match the <uuid:...> route converter and returns a 404 routing error.

test_cases.title: EmailModal composes a pre-filled follow-up email (component-level)
test_cases.preconditions: EmailModal mounted with a patient (NOTE: not currently wired into CallLogsPage — see DEF-CL-02; test via a mount harness/storybook or after wiring).
steps: Open the Email modal for a patient.
Inspect the Subject and Message Body defaults.
test_cases.expected_result: Title 'Send Email'; Subject defaults to 'Follow-up: Outreach from Saranam'; Body is pre-filled greeting the patient by full_name; both fields editable.

test_cases.title: Send Email is disabled when subject or body is empty
test_cases.preconditions: EmailModal open (per CL-071 caveat).
steps: Clear the Subject field entirely and observe the Send button.
Restore Subject, clear the Body, observe again.
Enter whitespace-only into Subject and observe.
test_cases.expected_result: 'Send Email' is disabled while !subject.trim() or !body.trim() (whitespace-only also disables it). Re-enabled once both contain non-whitespace text.

test_cases.title: Send Email posts to backend and closes on success
test_cases.preconditions: EmailModal open (per CL-071); patient has an email on file; onSend wired to callLogsApi.sendEmail.
steps: Edit subject/body and click 'Send Email'.
Inspect the Network call and modal behaviour.
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/send-email fires with {patient_id, subject, body}; on 200 {message:'Email sent successfully'} the modal closes (onClose). During send the button shows 'Sending...' and Cancel/Send are disabled.

test_cases.title: Send Email to a patient with no email on file returns 400
test_cases.preconditions: EmailModal open for a patient with NO email; onSend wired.
steps: Click 'Send Email'.
Inspect the Network response and console.
test_cases.test_data: Patient with no email on file
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/send-email returns 400 {"error":"Patient has no email address on file"} (or 404 if patient not found). The component logs 'Failed to send email' and the modal stays open (does not close on error).

test_cases.title: Send Email when SMTP is not configured returns 500
test_cases.preconditions: Backend SMTP settings absent; EmailModal open for a patient WITH an email.
steps: Click 'Send Email'.
Inspect the Network response.
test_cases.test_data: Patient with valid email; SMTP unset
test_cases.expected_result: POST /api/exotel/send-email returns 500 {"error":"SMTP settings not configured"}; modal stays open; the send button re-enables (loading reset).

test_cases.title: Cancel closes the Email modal without sending
test_cases.preconditions: EmailModal open with edits.
steps: Edit the body, then click 'Cancel' (and separately press Esc / click outside).
Confirm no send occurred.
test_cases.expected_result: The modal closes via onClose; no POST /api/exotel/send-email is sent; reopening resets the subject/body to defaults (via the open/patient effect).

test_cases.title: EmailModal hook-order crash when patient toggles null/non-null (KNOWN DEFECT)
test_cases.preconditions: EmailModal mounted; ability to pass patient as null then non-null (or vice versa).
steps: Render EmailModal with patient=null (early return null fires before the useEffect hook).
Then re-render with a non-null patient so the useEffect now runs.
Watch the React console / error overlay.
test_cases.expected_result: EXPECTED: clean render. ACTUAL (defect): `if (!patient) return null;` sits BEFORE the useEffect, violating the Rules of Hooks; React throws 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' when patient transitions from null to a value. Log as FAIL and reference DEF-CL-03.

test_cases.title: Guarded endpoints reject requests without a JWT (401)
test_cases.preconditions: Tooling to call the backend with no Authorization header.
steps: Call GET /api/exotel/agents, GET /api/exotel/sop, GET /api/exotel/sop/history, GET /api/exotel/scheduler, POST /api/exotel/send-email each WITHOUT a Bearer token.
Inspect each response.
test_cases.expected_result: Each returns 401 Unauthorized (JWT required). In the browser this triggers the client refresh-then-redirect flow.

test_cases.title: Telephony endpoints are publicly reachable without JWT (KNOWN DEFECT)
test_cases.preconditions: Tooling to call the backend with no Authorization header.
steps: Call GET /api/exotel/calls with no token.
Call POST /api/exotel/make-call with {from,to} and no token.
Call GET /api/exotel/call-status/<sid> with no token.
Inspect responses.
test_cases.expected_result: EXPECTED: these should require admin auth like the rest of the module. ACTUAL (defect): /api/exotel/calls, /make-call and /call-status/<sid> have NO @jwt_required guard and respond without authentication (an unauthenticated party could read call logs or place Exotel calls). Log as FAIL and reference DEF-CL-04.

test_cases.title: agent-status PUT validates required body fields (400)
test_cases.preconditions: Tooling to PUT with a valid JWT.
steps: PUT /api/exotel/agent-status with body {} (no provider_id/is_on_duty).
Inspect the response.
test_cases.expected_result: Backend returns 400 {"error":"Missing provider_id or is_on_duty"}.

test_cases.title: send-email validates required body fields (400)
test_cases.preconditions: Tooling to POST with a valid JWT.
steps: POST /api/exotel/send-email with body {patient_id:'x'} (no subject/body).
Inspect the response.
test_cases.expected_result: Backend returns 400 {"error":"patient_id, subject, and body are required"}.

test_cases.title: A saved SOP appears in SOP history and the patient record
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; SOP saved for a known patient (CL-038).
steps: Save an SOP for patient Ramesh Kumar with a distinct reason.
Go to History > SOP Documentation and locate the record.
(If accessible) open the patient's record in the Patients module to confirm linkage.
test_cases.expected_result: The newly saved SOP appears in GET /api/exotel/sop/history for the current range with the correct patient name, staff and reason; the record is tied to the patient_id sent on save.

test_cases.title: Removing a schedule item keeps it gone after a full page reload
test_cases.preconditions: Admin; >=1 schedule record (CL-064 just removed one).
steps: Remove a schedule record on the Scheduler tab.
Hard-reload the page and return to the Scheduler tab.
Confirm the record is absent.
test_cases.expected_result: After DELETE and a fresh GET /api/exotel/scheduler the removed record does not reappear (deletion is persisted server-side), unlike the client-only Dismiss in CL-060.

test_cases.title: Tab data is scoped/loaded only for the active tab
test_cases.preconditions: Admin on /call-logs; Network tab open.
steps: Watch the Network tab while clicking through Dial -> History -> Escalated -> Scheduler.
Confirm which fetches fire per tab.
test_cases.expected_result: Dial fetches patients + agents; History (calls sub-tab) fetches exotel/calls; History (docs sub-tab) fetches sop/history; Escalated fetches exotel/sop; Scheduler fetches exotel/scheduler. Inactive-tab fetches are guarded (return early) so they do not fire.
